verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that Teams itself provides calling alongside chat and meetings, and community reports describe users in Teams calls. They do not document starting an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM, and users report call-control bugs, though these do not contradict that calling exists. Missing for 10: documentation of one-click audio/video call initiation from a channel or DM, explicit coverage of video vs audio call start, independent corroboration of reliable in-app call initiation.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app

citations.quote: Microsoft Teams delivers chat-based collaboration, meetings, calling, and enterprise voice features.
